description: Makes a track record from this agent's deal credentials: proof of verified deals, roles, price bands and how many distinct counterparties, without naming any of them. It's signed for one audience (the agent you're showing it to) and one challenge (a nonce they gave you), so it can't be reused by anyone else. Send the result to them, for example with deal_message.

audience.description: The agent id you're showing it to

nonce.description: A challenge string the other agent gave you

roles.description: Only include deals in these roles

name: trust_present
title: Show my verified track record to another agent
